REGRESSION: property/{id} detail page shows add-to-list-btn and body-text regex scan returned 0 phone-like strings and 0 non-amass email strings (conversion gate still holds). Known limitation: tab-neighbours regression at '/' was previously verified green in iter_51; this run couldn't retest it because the fresh browser session showed the FIXA onboarding splash before auth could re-attach — not a bug, just a session-isolation artifact. Benign repeating console warnings: 'shadow*' deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated — pre-existing, flagged in iter_51. No red-screen errors. No HIGH-priority bugs found. 21/21 backend tests pass. All frontend testIDs in the review brief render correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin cockpit dashboard correctly uses int cast on count_documents results (admin_cockpit.py:71-72) and exposes pending_estates + open_social_reports, matching the tile-neighbours badge formula on /admin index.
Seed route (server.py:1866) correctly short-circuits on dry_run before calling _do_seed (which wipes listings) — verified: /properties total unchanged after dry_run call.

Admin funnel attribution object includes all 7 vias and each via has both payments_completed (ledger truth) + paid_action_starts (client-event directional). The money hero on the UI correctly computes social share from SOCIAL_VIA = [friend,collection,estate,recommendation] subset (/admin/neighbours.tsx:24).

/community/admin/estates and /community/admin/estates/{id}/review are both admin-gated (401 unauth / 403 non-admin). Approve path correctly flips approver's estate_members row to role=manager + status=approved as part of the review action (confirmed via end-to-end test).

/social/admin/reports/{id}/resolve is admin-gated; the resolveReport() handler in /admin/neighbours.tsx:103 wisely optimistically drops ALL open reports on the same target (same target_type + target_id) rather than just the one id — matches backend behaviour and prevents duplicate action from the admin on sibling reports.
Non-admin gate on /admin/neighbours uses the EmptyState variant='error' at /admin/neighbours.tsx:120 — reads useAuth().user.is_admin before loading data, so no API probe leaks.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create transient TEST_* users + 1 TEST_Estate_* per run (approved during the e2e test, left in db.estates with status=active — harmless, no cleanup needed since estate names are suffixed with uuid). Frontend run created 2 pending estates ('TEST Estate baf44' approved, 'Oniru Palm Court 20039' left pending) and 1 extra spam report on the Lekki Gardens Q&A post (hidden). None of this interferes with regression — scoped to demo estate + unique uuids.
context_for_next_testing_agent: (a) /auth/login response field is 'access_token' (NOT 'token') — tests that assume 'token' will error out at module import time via fixtures. See /app/backend/tests/test_admin_neighbours_review.py for the correct pattern. (b) /api/properties returns a plain list (not {items,total}), so use len(response_json) for counting. (c) The admin cockpit tile-neighbours badge is pending_estates + open_social_reports (both counted independently), not just one. (d) Confirm sheet testID is 'nb-admin-confirm' and the cancel button is 'nb-admin-confirm-cancel' — the Sheet component only mounts in DOM while visible=true. (e) resolveReport() on the client optimistically removes ALL open reports on the same target, so if there are 3 open reports on the same post and you hide 1, you'll see 3 cards disappear from the Open list but only 1 action request is sent — this is by design, matches backend fan-out behaviour. (f) To avoid the FIXA onboarding splash when re-testing /, log in via /(auth)/login FIRST, then navigate to '/' — the splash is one-time per localStorage key. (g) 21 new tests take ~2.4s to run; safe to add to the overall suite.
